AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain General Animal Health and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Beekeeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project 3.0 Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship 3.1 To and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

2. B — Glucose and oxygen

3. B — 100 °C

4. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.

6. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.

8. B — Ice melting to water

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

10. D — newton (N)

11. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General Animal Health; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
